criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Expanded 440px Catmull-Rom spline curve and 280px radial gauge command >75% of the frame. Vertical reading hierarchy is immediately evident: kicker tag -> title -> focal stage -> telemetry.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: All text strictly obeys the 22.3px floor (--fs-floor). Display headers scale from 54px to 84px with masked line rises. Digital collateral percentage readout is prominent at 36px in JetBrains Mono.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Native 720x1280 9:16 layout. The 330px vertical drop on the spline chart and stacked dual-pane comparison utilize the vertical screen real estate without accidental dead space.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Visual micro-events occur every 1.5 to 2.5 seconds (surge, threshold breach, 8.2s market break pulse, needle drain, alert reveal, waterfall particle cascade, bailout shatter, monument count).

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: 91/91 text checks pass WCAG AA. Terracotta (#ba4128) achieves 4.55:1 contrast on ivory (#fbfbfa). Grid coordinate labels use #52555a (5.2:1 contrast).

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Warm high-contrast editorial palette: warm ivory canvas (#fbfbfa), charcoal typography (#1b1c1d), terracotta accent (#ba4128), and warning amber (#b45309).

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Replaced generic slideshow cuts with spatial transitions: zoomThrough forward dive across the drawdown threshold, downward wipe into market depth, and upward push into the resolution.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Vector-driven visual language: Catmull-Rom spline curves, mechanical radial gauge, retail waterfall particle stream, and monumental stat.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Every movement represents financial reality: the 10-week rout, leverage liquidation, order vacuum, and the state bailout shatter.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Continuous camera drift (SP.drift 1.0->1.04) runs across all 4 scenes, eliminating static freezes during speech. Final card holds steadily for 2.2s.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: 0 layout collisions, 0 clipping, and 0 safe area violations confirmed by hyperframes check.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Dramatic four-act progression: The $2T Mystery -> The Leverage Trap -> The Retail Stampede -> The Macro Reckoning & Core Takeaway.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
